title: Pan-Seared Mushroom Bowl
description: A hearty and flavorful bowl dish featuring sautéed mushrooms and a tangy quick fix sauce. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil, mediterranean seasoning, and a pinch of salt and pepper to the skillet. Stir to combine.
Pour the quick fix sauce over the mushrooms and stir to coat.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 2-3 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Serve the mushroom mixture over a bed of hot rice or noodles, topped with a dollop of sour cream if desired.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, such as parsley or dill, if desired.
